MH01.question: Why did base-crack warranty claims rise at our Durgapur plant in 2025?
MH01.answer_text: The Durgapur (DGP) plant's base-crack claims per 1,000 units spiked in March–April 2025 (76.1 and 61.0 vs ~15–24 in other months), and the lot_scan anomaly detector traces this to a single resin lot, RL-DGP-L2-250310 (line 2), which was flagged on 2025-05-18 with 291 base-crack claims on 3,376 units — an effect size of 3.84 (p ≈ 9e-79) versus ~76 expected claims across 10 peer lots. In other words, the 2025 rise is concentrated in one defective resin lot used on line 2, not a broad plant-wide problem.
sql:
with params as (
    select coalesce(NULL::date, (select max(snapshot_date) from marts.mart_anomaly_flags)) as as_of
),
latest as (
    select distinct on (f.detector, f.entity_type, f.entity_id, f.failure_mode, f.details ->> 'category') f.*
    from marts.mart_anomaly_flags f, params p
    where f.snapshot_date <= p.as_of
    order by f.detector, f.entity_type, f.entity_id, f.failure_mode, f.details ->> 'category', f.snapshot_date desc
)
select p.as_of, l.detector, l.entity_type, l.entity_id, l.failure_mode, l.region, l.snapshot_date,
       l.first_flag_date, l.effect_size, l.p_value, l.details
from latest l, params p
where l.first_flag_date <= p.as_of
  and ('lot_scan'::text is null or l.detector = 'lot_scan')
  and ('base_crack'::text is null or l.failure_mode = 'base_crack')
-- Strongest first within each detector, interleaved across detectors (D34): the model reads only the first rows, so
-- one detector's long list must not push the others out of view.
order by row_number() over (partition by l.detector order by l.effect_size desc nulls last, l.entity_id, l.failure_mode),
         l.detector

SELECT
  metric_time__month
  , 1000 * claims / nullif(units, 0) AS base_crack_claims_per_1000_units
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(cohort_base_crack_claims) AS claims
    , SUM(cohort_units_shipped) AS units
  FROM (
    SELECT
      subq_2.metric_time__month AS metric_time__month
      , batches_src_10000.plant_id AS batch__plant_id
      , subq_2.__cohort_base_crack_claims AS cohort_base_crack_claims
      , subq_2.__cohort_units_shipped AS cohort_units_shipped
    FROM (
      SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', mfg_date) AS metric_time__month
        , batch_id AS batch
        , claims_base_crack AS __cohort_base_crack_claims
        , case when months_since_ship = 0 then units_shipped else 0 end AS __cohort_units_shipped
      FROM "marts"."mart_batch_claim_cohorts" batch_claim_cohorts_src_10000
      WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', mfg_date) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    ) subq_2
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      "marts"."dim_batch" batches_src_10000
    ON
      subq_2.batch = batches_src_10000.batch_id
  ) subq_7
  WHERE batch__plant_id = 'DGP'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_11
ORDER BY metric_time__month
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  batch
  , batch__line_no
  , batch__product__product_name
  , 1000 * claims / nullif(units, 0) AS base_crack_claims_per_1000_units
FROM (
  SELECT
    batch
    , batch__line_no
    , batch__product__product_name
    , SUM(cohort_base_crack_claims) AS claims
    , SUM(cohort_units_shipped) AS units
  FROM (
    SELECT
      subq_19.batch AS batch
      , subq_25.line_no AS batch__line_no
      , subq_25.resin_lot_id AS batch__resin_lot_id
      , subq_25.product__product_name AS batch__product__product_name
      , subq_19.__cohort_base_crack_claims AS cohort_base_crack_claims
      , subq_19.__cohort_units_shipped AS cohort_units_shipped
    FROM (
      SELECT
        batch_id AS batch
        , claims_base_crack AS __cohort_base_crack_claims
        , case when months_since_ship = 0 then units_shipped else 0 end AS __cohort_units_shipped
      FROM "marts"."mart_batch_claim_cohorts" batch_claim_cohorts_src_10000
    ) subq_19
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT
        batches_src_10000.batch_id AS batch
        , batches_src_10000.line_no AS line_no
        , batches_src_10000.resin_lot_id AS resin_lot_id
        , products_src_10000.product_name AS product__product_name
      FROM "marts"."dim_batch" batches_src_10000
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        "marts"."dim_product" products_src_10000
      ON
        batches_src_10000.sku = products_src_10000.sku
    ) subq_25
    ON
      subq_19.batch = subq_25.batch
  ) subq_27
  WHERE batch__resin_lot_id = 'RL-DGP-L2-250310'
  GROUP BY
    batch
    , batch__line_no
    , batch__product__product_name
) subq_31
ORDER BY base_crack_claims_per_1000_units DESC, batch, batch__line_no, batch__product__product_name
LIMIT 500

select p.as_of, l.detector, l.entity_type, l.entity_id, l.failure_mode, l.region, l.snapshot_date,
       l.first_flag_date, l.effect_size, l.p_value, l.details
from latest l, params p
where l.first_flag_date <= p.as_of
  and ('lot_scan'::text is null or l.detector = 'lot_scan')
  and ('base_crack'::text is null or l.failure_mode = 'base_crack')
-- Strongest first within each detector, interleaved across detectors (D34): the model reads only the first rows, so
-- one detector's long list must not push the others out of view.
order by row_number() over (partition by l.detector order by l.effect_size desc nulls last, l.entity_id, l.failure_mode),
         l.detector

SELECT
  metric_time__month
  , 1000 * claims / nullif(units, 0) AS base_crack_claims_per_1000_units
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(cohort_base_crack_claims) AS claims
    , SUM(cohort_units_shipped) AS units
  FROM (
    SELECT
      subq_2.metric_time__month AS metric_time__month
      , batches_src_10000.plant_id AS batch__plant_id
      , subq_2.__cohort_base_crack_claims AS cohort_base_crack_claims
      , subq_2.__cohort_units_shipped AS cohort_units_shipped
    FROM (
      SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', mfg_date) AS metric_time__month
        , batch_id AS batch
        , claims_base_crack AS __cohort_base_crack_claims
        , case when months_since_ship = 0 then units_shipped else 0 end AS __cohort_units_shipped
      FROM "marts"."mart_batch_claim_cohorts" batch_claim_cohorts_src_10000
      WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', mfg_date) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    ) subq_2
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      "marts"."dim_batch" batches_src_10000
    ON
      subq_2.batch = batches_src_10000.batch_id
  ) subq_7
  WHERE batch__plant_id = 'DGP'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_11
ORDER BY metric_time__month
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  batch
  , batch__line_no
  , batch__product__product_name
  , 1000 * claims / nullif(units, 0) AS base_crack_claims_per_1000_units
FROM (
  SELECT
    batch
    , batch__line_no
    , batch__product__product_name
    , SUM(cohort_base_crack_claims) AS claims
    , SUM(cohort_units_shipped) AS units
  FROM (
    SELECT
      subq_19.batch AS batch
      , subq_25.line_no AS batch__line_no
      , subq_25.resin_lot_id AS batch__resin_lot_id
      , subq_25.product__product_name AS batch__product__product_name
      , subq_19.__cohort_base_crack_claims AS cohort_base_crack_claims
      , subq_19.__cohort_units_shipped AS cohort_units_shipped
    FROM (
      SELECT
        batch_id AS batch
        , claims_base_crack AS __cohort_base_crack_claims
        , case when months_since_ship = 0 then units_shipped else 0 end AS __cohort_units_shipped
      FROM "marts"."mart_batch_claim_cohorts" batch_claim_cohorts_src_10000
    ) subq_19
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT
        batches_src_10000.batch_id AS batch
        , batches_src_10000.line_no AS line_no
        , batches_src_10000.resin_lot_id AS resin_lot_id
        , products_src_10000.product_name AS product__product_name
      FROM "marts"."dim_batch" batches_src_10000
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        "marts"."dim_product" products_src_10000
      ON
        batches_src_10000.sku = products_src_10000.sku
    ) subq_25
    ON
      subq_19.batch = subq_25.batch
  ) subq_27
  WHERE batch__resin_lot_id = 'RL-DGP-L2-250310'
  GROUP BY
    batch
    , batch__line_no
    , batch__product__product_name
) subq_31
ORDER BY base_crack_claims_per_1000_units DESC, batch, batch__line_no, batch__product__product_name
LIMIT 500
